To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
our application streaming framework achieves low latency and high image quality, even for demanding 3D applications.

our distributed rendering architecture in combination with real-time ETC-1 compression achieves a 2.2x higher image quality and a 1.9x lower latency compared to a single-server streaming architecture.
our framework is able to stream high-quality multimedia applications from a high-end server to a mobile device with a latency of 100ms, which is low enough for interactive usage.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following topics: (1) A novel application streaming framework for in-home streaming of interactive applications to mobile devices.
the development and evaluation of an application streaming solution for high-end applications on mobile devices.

the following aspects: (1) the design and implementation of a distributed rendering architecture, (2) a real-time compression algorithm for ETC1 texture compression and (3) an evaluation of the resulting in-home streaming solution.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presented approach is a significant improvement to the current state of the art in application streaming.
our framework provides a high quality, low latency, in-home streaming of applications for mobile devices.
the presented solution is the best inhome streaming solution for mobile devices.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have successfully implemented a streaming solution that can be used to stream any OpenGL ES application.
we have developed a streaming framework that allows for high quality, low latency streaming of applications to mobile devices.
the proposed framework allows for high quality, low latency multimedia applications on mobile devices.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the performance of mobile devices is not limited by their own processing power, but by the available wireless bandwidth.
the performance of mobile devices is no longer the main limiting factor in the context of in-home streaming, but rather the available bandwidth and the image compression scheme.

we are now able to deliver high quality, low latency multimedia applications to mobile devices, which can be used to run applications on high-end machines that would not be able to run on the mobile devices themselves.
